properties.title: 76 Southbank retrofit and extension reached built status
properties.explanation: The former IBM building entered a documented built phase after refurbishment and extension into modern workspace, with conservation, structure, services, landscape, facade, heritage, and transport project credits recorded.

properties.title: Alfred Place refurbishment reached built status
properties.explanation: A documented central London office refurbishment reached built status, improving links to Alfred Place Gardens and updating terraces and shared tenant spaces.

properties.title: Angel Square reached built status above Angel station
properties.explanation: A prominent Islington office-led site above Angel station entered built status with retained concrete structure, new active frontages, a moved public house, and new connections.

properties.title: Brixton Recreation Centre public-realm works reached built status
properties.explanation: Public space, facade, unused internal spaces, workspaces, lighting, and signage at the Grade II listed recreation centre and adjacent streets reached a documented built milestone.

properties.title: Charter School East Dulwich opened its completed new home
properties.explanation: A former hospital site completed its transition into permanent secondary school accommodation with specialist and sixth-form space.

properties.title: Cox's Walk footbridge reopened after restoration
properties.explanation: A restored historic pedestrian bridge re-entered public use across the former railway cutting between Dulwich and Sydenham Hill Woods.

properties.title: Dolphin Square restoration reached built status
properties.explanation: A large heritage residential estate reached a documented built milestone with upgraded homes, restored gardens, communal amenities, low-carbon improvements, and project team credits recorded by NLA.

properties.title: Edenica completed at 100 Fetter Lane
properties.explanation: A new workplace building at 100 Fetter Lane entered built status with landscaped terraces, public pocket park, ground-floor cafe frontage, and pub-related street activation.

properties.title: Little Gearies affordable homes reached built status
properties.explanation: A documented affordable-housing scheme reached built status on the Little Gearies estate.

properties.title: Metropolis adaptive reuse reached built status
properties.explanation: A documented mid-century office retrofit reached built status as a commercial hub with new workplace and wellbeing-led design features.

properties.title: Minerva Works circular economy hub opened in Park Royal
properties.explanation: A vacant industrial building entered documented interim use as a workspace for circular-economy enterprises in Park Royal.

properties.title: Morpeth Road key-worker homes reached built status
properties.explanation: A backland garage plot entered use as a small mews of courtyard houses for local key workers, with a documented architect and client.

properties.title: One Millennium Bridge retrofit reached built status
properties.explanation: A retained office building beside the Thames was recorded as a completed retrofit with activated river frontage and a publicly accessible rooftop element.

properties.title: Royal Albert Wharf reached built status
properties.explanation: A documented housing-led regeneration scheme reached built status, adding homes, affordable housing, commercial space, and artist-studio provision on GLA land.

properties.title: Sadler's Wells East officially opened
properties.explanation: A purpose-built dance theatre entered use in east London's new culture and education district.

properties.title: Seed 130 gallery fit-out reached built status
properties.explanation: A former retail unit in Fountain House entered use as a contemporary art gallery and cultural project space with design, engineering, planning, cultural, and delivery partners recorded.

properties.title: Silvertown Tunnel opened under the Thames
properties.explanation: A new cross-river road tunnel and associated bus and cycle-shuttle infrastructure entered operation in east London.

properties.title: Silvertown Tunnel portal buildings reached built status
properties.explanation: Documented operational portal buildings were delivered at either end of the Thames road tunnel, adding architectural identity and working spaces to the infrastructure project.

properties.title: Sloane Street public-realm transformation completed
properties.explanation: Sloane Street was reworked as a greener pedestrian-priority boulevard with widened footways, new trees, lighting, planting, and bespoke ironwork details.

properties.title: Soho Theatre Walthamstow opened after Granada restoration
properties.explanation: A restored Grade II* former cinema entered new use as a 960-seat theatre and cultural venue in Walthamstow.

properties.title: Springfield Park opened in Tooting
properties.explanation: A large new public park and associated civic landscape entered public use on the Springfield University Hospital estate.

properties.title: The Acre reached built status in Covent Garden
properties.explanation: A 1970s Covent Garden office building was reworked into a renewed workplace with retained structure, terraces, central atrium, cafe, and unified circulation.

properties.title: V&A East Storehouse opened to the public
properties.explanation: A new public-facing museum store and collection-care building entered use at East Bank.

properties.title: Walworth Town Hall restoration reached built status
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-led refurbishment returned the fire-damaged town hall to use with flexible workspaces, public amenities, cafe, restaurant, and community centre space.

properties.title: Yelverton Road mixed-use scheme reached built status
properties.explanation: A residential-led mixed-use building at 5 Yelverton Road entered built status with homes plus employment and creative workspace.

properties.title: Zodiac reached built status in Croydon
properties.explanation: A documented adaptive-reuse housing project reached built status on London Road in Broad Green.
